title: Ramp + Recruit 1:1 checklist and hiring sync prep
content:
Quick prep notes for upcoming 1:1s + weekly hiring sync. This is a personal scratchpad — will convert the high-level asks into the agenda doc after syncing with Noor. Tone = pragmatic, ask for clear decisions, avoid open-ended brainstorming in the meeting.

Topline goals (context)
- Q2 hiring plan: net +6 ICs across infra (3), platform (2), applied-ml (1). Budget signoff pending — finance meeting next Tue.
- Time-to-offer target: 28 days average from first screen to offer for IC roles. Benchmark: currently ~38 days.

Current pipeline snapshot (rough counts, to mention in sync)
- Sourced candidates (active): 48
- Screened / phone screens scheduled this week: 12
- Onsite loops scheduled: 5 (2 infra, 2 platform, 1 applied-ml)
- Offers extended / pending: 2 (one accepted verbally, awaiting paperwork)
- Candidate falloff / no-shows this month: 8 (mainly senior infra; ask ops for no-show reasons)

Agenda items for 1:1 with Diego (30 min)
- 3 min: confirm his top 3 hiring priorities (does he still want infra GPU engineer x3 or shift one to SRE?)
- 5 min: calendar blockers for interviewers (who is overbooked next 3 weeks) — ask for names to reassign
- 7 min: debrief on recent senior infra candidate (J. Park) — decision timeline, red flags we saw
- 5 min: ramp risk discussion — onboarding capacity for 3 hires in April; mentorship bandwidth (Noor +2 mentors)
- 5 min: action alignment (who will edit req language, who will clear budget ticket)

Interview loop timing & hygiene (things to enforce)
- Pre-loop checklist (recruiter + hiring manager must sign off): interview guide, rubric, optional take-home test (if used)
- Standard loop length target: 3 interviews in 1 day (screen + 2 deep dives) or split across 2 days max
- Interviewers: keep panels <=4 people, avoid consecutive behavioral-heavy interviews
- Expectation: each interviewer submits debrief within 24h; follow-up slot scheduled within 48h of final loop
- No more than 2 interview reschedules per candidate before automatic reassessment by recruiter

Debrief rubric (quick form to push to hiring managers)
- Skills fit: 1-5
- Culture/team fit: 1-5
- System design depth (if applicable): 1-5
- Signals: ownership, execution examples, ambiguity tolerance (short notes)
- Red/green flags (list) + recommended next step (hire / second-stage / pass)

Calibration & interviewer coaching notes
- Run a 20-min calibration session next Wed for infra team (goal: align on rubric scales and examples). Bring 3 anonymized debriefs.
- Reminder for new interviewers: avoid whiteboard puzzles that are irrelevant to day-to-day; prefer system design prompts tied to our stack.

Operational blockers to raise in weekly hiring sync
- Recruiter capacity: Jasmin overloaded with Senior infra reqs — suggest adding contract sourcer (2 mo) to reduce TTFD
- Interviewer bandwidth: platform managers on travel 3/16–3/27; need temporary interviewer swaps
- Offer approvals: delays in legal for relocation clauses — ask Legal for 48h SLA for exec-level offers

Immediate action list (who -> what)
- Audrey: update req language for infra-GPU role by Fri 3/6 (focus on performance infra experience, add quantization exposure as bonus)
- Diego: confirm mentor assignments and capacity for April hires by 3/8
- Noor: schedule calibration session, send calendar invite + 3 sample debriefs by 3/5
- Jasmin: provide pipline breakdown (sourced / screened / onsite) as csv before weekly sync on 3/7
- People-ops: escalate legal SLA for offers via ticket HR-1234 (assign to Priya)

Slack templates (copy/paste)
- Interviewer ask: "Hey <name>, can you spare 60m next week to do an interview for the infra-GPU loop? We aim to keep loops compact; I'll send the interviewer guide. If you can't, please suggest 2 colleagues. Thanks! —Audrey"
- Post-loop nudges: "Quick reminder to add your debrief for candidate <first-last> from yesterday. We need inputs to make a decision by EOD tomorrow."

Open questions / considerations (to bring up)
- Do we prioritize time-to-offer or candidate quality for senior infra roles? (Tradeoff: faster offers may increase risk of mismatch.)
- Should we standardize a single take-home for applied-ml, or continue manager-specific evaluations?
- Can we experiment with a 5-day accelerated path for top-tier candidates (tighten scheduling/resource commitment)?

Notes to self (post-meeting follow-up)
- Convert action list into a shared ticket board and tag owners.
- Draft an FAQ for candidates about relocation + visa timeline (Legal input needed).
- Pull data on interviewer debrief turnaround the past 6 months for calibration meeting.
